method: Original PNG actually opened separately at original resolution once before spec construction.
sourceFacts: One common pressure-versus-temperature frame: upward p axis, rightward t axis, numeric origin 0. No numbered scale ticks.
One smooth increasing, convex saturation curve, starting above the horizontal axis and continuing beyond the upper-right construction intersection.
Black B lies on the curve at lower pressure p1 and temperature tp. Black A is to its right at exactly the same pressure p1, below the curve at t1.
A solid horizontal segment joins B and A without a directional arrow. A dashed horizontal p1 guide joins the vertical axis to B.
Upper dashed p0 guide reaches the saturation curve vertically above A. One dashed vertical guide through A continues from that intersection to the t1 axis projection.
A separate dashed vertical guide from B reaches the tp axis projection. Thus tp<t1 and p1<p0; labels are p, t, 0, p0, p1, tp, t1, A, B.
There is no legend, unit calibration, numerical pressure or temperature, separate second curve, heater or direction arrow on the cooling path.
glyphLimits: The source p-shaped subscript of t is interpreted through the canonical source t_p notation, not claimed to distinguish identical Latin/Cyrillic pixel shapes.
regularization: Equalized guide strokes, smooth curve interpolation through the source-required B and upper-t1 intersections, readable Latin mathematical labels. Coordinates are schematic layout values, never measured source temperatures or pressures.
scientificScope: Original fixed-water-partial-pressure path A to B until saturation; B lies on the water saturation curve and A is unsaturated. Full frozen lesson includes separate apparatus and worked-example topics but no added figure data or answer annotations.
